evidence.summary: All current delivery creation paths hold the same collection lock through commit. Watch reads delivery order in a repeatable-read snapshot and binds cursor to inbox/filter/destination/generation. The CLI owns one page, one client and one cursor lock; output precedes fsynced atomic checkpoint. Only transport errors retry; structured refusals stop. Pipe cancellation closes a pollable descriptor; cleanup releases cursor lock and HTTP resources.

Recovery/reissue and scheduling remain unimplemented; full v1 is not accepted.
